questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: An inference that follows and one that does not
questions.learningObjective: Identify a valid inference from survey notes
questions.stem: A field biologist notes 'Otters were absent from the north bank on three surveys.' What follows?

questions.explanation: Absence on three surveys supports reduced likelihood, not extinction or exclusivity. The tempting overreach turns limited data into a universal claim.
questions.hint: Match the strength of the conclusion to the data.
